Package com.lucaf.robotic_core.KERN.ui

Class MonitoringSerialConnector

java.lang.Object
com.lucaf.robotic_core.dataInterfaces.impl.IOInterface
com.lucaf.robotic_core.dataInterfaces.impl.SerialInterface
com.lucaf.robotic_core.dataInterfaces.serial.SimpleSerialConnector
com.lucaf.robotic_core.KERN.ui.MonitoringSerialConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
jssc.SerialPortEventListener
public class MonitoringSerialConnector extends SimpleSerialConnector
A SimpleSerialConnector that reports every byte crossing the serial line to a traffic listener, so that a UI can display the raw conversation with the device in real time.

Outgoing traffic is trivial to intercept (send(byte[])). Incoming traffic is not: the SerialEvent handed to the data listeners reads straight from the port, so whichever listener calls readBytes() first consumes the data and every other listener sees an empty buffer. To avoid stealing the payload from the scale, this connector drains the port once in emitDataEvent(SerialEvent), reports the bytes to the traffic listener and then forwards a MonitoringSerialConnector.BufferedSerialEvent that replays the very same buffer to the downstream listeners.
